visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a slow, appetising extreme close-up pan of a finished Thai cold squid salad. The dish is vibrant with white scored squid pieces, bright red cherry tomato halves, green cilantro sprigs, and yellow lemon slices, all glistening in a clear sauce. (2) We see a top-down close-up of a person's hands using a sharp chef's knife to carefully score a fresh, white piece of squid in a tight diamond pattern on a clean wooden cutting board. (3) The scene shifts to a medium shot of a male chef, Max, standing in a brightly lit studio kitchen with a white brick wall. He is wearing a professional white chef's coat with embroidered logos and gestures enthusiastically towards the counter. (4) In a close-up, a hand drops several fresh lemon slices into a beige ceramic-coated pan of boiling water, creating small ripples and steam. (5) Using black kitchen tongs, the chef adds the scored squid pieces into the boiling lemon-infused water for a quick blanch, then promptly transfers them to a clear glass bowl filled with cold water. (6) The camera focuses on a manual pull-chopper on a wooden counter. Hands add green chili peppers, halved red shallots, and fresh cilantro leaves into the plastic container. (7) A close-up shows the chef pulling the blue handle of the manual chopper repeatedly, rapidly mincing the ingredients. Whole cherry tomatoes are added to the mix for a final brief pulse. (8) The minced green and red mixture is emptied into a glass bowl. Hands pour various liquid seasonings—sesame oil, vinegar, and sauces—from small glass containers into the bowl. (9) The chef uses wooden chopsticks to stir the colorful sauce mixture, adding more lemon slices and tomato halves to enhance the presentation and flavor profile. (10) The final phase returns to a close-up of the blanched squid being topped with the aromatic Thai sauce, showcasing the texture and freshness of the completed dish.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with an energetic, high-tempo pop track featuring bright acoustic guitars and a driving electronic beat. A male voice introduces the Thai dish with high arousal and a positive, welcoming tone. (2) Distinct rhythmic transients of a knife striking a wooden board are heard, synchronized with the narration describing the squid cutting technique. The BGM remains constant in the background. (3) A sound of bubbling water and the metallic click of tongs accompanies the chef's description of blanching. Short splash sounds occur as lemons and squid enter the water. (4) The audio transitions to a series of mechanical zipping and whirring sounds caused by the manual pull-chopper. This percussive texture is prominent over the narration. (5) Liquid pouring sounds and the high-pitched clinking of glass containers are heard as dressings are added. The chef's speech maintains a fast, clear pace. (6) The final phase features soft scraping and stirring sounds of chopsticks in a glass bowl, concluding with the chef's upbeat sign-off as the music swells for the final logo reveal.
